sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, the division leaders with 22 points from 10 games, travel to Alsager Town on Saturday in their sole fixture this week. The league table shows Alsager Town struggling at the bottom with just 4 points from 10 matches, having lost their last four games in succession. Sandbach arrive in outstanding form with five consecutive wins before their most recent draw, making them heavy favorites to extend their unbeaten run.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host Dawley Town in a match where Stafford will look to keep pace with Sandbach after their recent draw. AFC Bridgnorth, third in the table, face a test against Eccleshall, who sit fifth but have lost their last match. Wolverhampton Casuals, joint-third, visit Wednesfield Community in a mid-table encounter. Bilston Town, sixth and in good form with a recent win, host Foley Meir at home. Barnton entertain Shawbury United in a fixture between mid-table sides, while New Mills face Market Drayton Town away in a contest between two sides searching for consistent form. Crewe host Allscott Heath, with both teams from the lower reaches of the table, and Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to face Telford Town in a basement battle between two of the division's weakest performers. Brereton Social host Widnes Town, where Widnes arrive having lost their last match with minimal points accumulated all season.
